bio: Frank Darabont is a Hungarian-American film director, screenwriter, and producer. He has directed and written several critically acclaimed films, including 'The Shawshank Redemption'.
Francis Ford Coppola is an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is a central figure in the New Hollywood film movement of the 1960s and 1970s.
Christopher Nolan is a British-American film director, screenwriter, and producer. His films have grossed over US$5 billion worldwide and have earned 11 Academy Awards from 36 nominations.
Sidney Lumet was an American film director, producer, and screenwriter with over 50 films to his credit.
Steven Spielberg is an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is one of the most commercially successful directors in history.
Sir Peter Jackson is a New Zealand film director, screenwriter, and producer. He is best known for his adaptations of J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Lord of the Rings' trilogy.
Quentin Tarantino is an American film director, screenwriter, producer, and actor. His films are characterized by non-linear storylines, stylized violence, and ensemble casts.
Robert Zemeckis is an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is known for directing films such as 'Forrest Gump' and 'Cast Away'.
Sergio Leone was an Italian film director, producer, and screenwriter, most famous for his pioneering work in the Spaghetti Western genre.
David Fincher is an American film director and producer. His films often explore dark, psychological themes and have a distinct visual style.
Martin Scorsese is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and actor. He is widely regarded as one of the most significant and influential filmmakers in cinematic history.
Sir Alfred Hitchcock was an English film director and producer. He is widely regarded as one of the most influential figures in cinema history.

Hayao Miyazaki is a Japanese film director, producer, screenwriter, animator, author, and manga artist. A co-founder of Studio Ghibli, he has attained international acclaim as a masterful storyteller and a creator of animated feature films.
Denis Villeneuve is a Canadian film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is a four-time winner of the Canadian Screen Award for Best Director.
Stanley Kubrick was an American film director, screenwriter, producer, and photographer. He is frequently cited as one of the greatest and most influential directors in cinematic history.

Billy Wilder was an Austrian-American film director, screenwriter, and producer. His career spanned more than five decades and he is regarded as one of the most versatile and influential filmmakers of Hollywood's Golden Age.
James Cameron is a Canadian film director, producer, screenwriter, inventor, and deep-sea explorer. He has directed some of the highest-grossing films of all time.
Orson Welles was an American film director, actor, screenwriter, and producer who is remembered for his innovative work in film, theatre, and radio.

Buster Keaton was an American actor, comedian, film director, producer, screenwriter, and stunt performer. He is best known for his silent films, in which his trademark was physical comedy with a consistently stoic, deadpan expression.
